# Let's try various zone ID patterns to find one that crashes
import subprocess
import os

fuzzer = "/workspace/repo-vul/work-vul/meson/fuzzing/fuzz_uri_parse"

patterns = [
    b"http://[::1%]/",
    b"http://[::1%2]/",
    b"http://[::1%25]/",
    b"http://[::1%25x]/",
    b"http://[::1%252]/",
    b"http://[::1%]/path",
    b"http://[::1%25]/path",
    b"http://[::1%]",
    b"http://[::1%25]",
    b"http://[::1%2]",
    b"http://[::1%]a",
    b"http://[::1%25]a",
    b"http://[::1%2]a",
    b"http://[::1%2525]/",
    b"http://[::1%]",
    b"http://[::1%25]",
    b"http://[::1%]",
    b"http://[::1%25]",
    b"http://[::1%25]",
    b"http://[::1%]",
]

for i, pat in enumerate(patterns):
    fname = f"/tmp/poc_zone_{i}.bin"
    with open(fname, "wb") as f:
        f.write(pat)
    result = subprocess.run([fuzzer, fname], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=5)
    print(f"Pattern {i}: {pat!r} -> exit={result.returncode}, stderr={result.stderr[:100] if result.stderr else 'none'}")
EOF
